caption: The drawing depicts a single vase centered on a plain, light-colored background. The vase is rendered in shades of teal green and has a classical form with a fluted, vertically-ribbed body that gently tapers toward the base. It features two large, symmetrical handles, each curving outward from the neck, turning downward, and then curling into decorative spirals near the base attachment. The vase sits on a square pedestal foot and has a wide, flared mouth with a slightly thicker rim. There are no other objects or significant background elements, and the signature "Van Silvay" appears in small letters near the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Vase
